claim: disrobe frisk recalls all 8 planted secrets in the committed planted-secrets.apk, and each of the 8 is named individually so one cannot lapse while another starts being found.
detail: 8 of 8 planted secrets recalled from corpus/recon/apk/planted-secrets.apk. The eight are named individually in this bar's membership list, so one secret cannot stop being found while another starts and leave the count at 8. The denominator is pinned by equality against the committed ground truth, so a run that inspects fewer secrets scores worse rather than shrinking what it is measured against.
gate_source: benches/head-to-head/src/frisk.rs test published_planted_apk_secret_bars_are_pinned_by_membership, which scans the committed apk and asserts every named secret is recalled; the ground truth is the planted token list, not frisk's own output

oracle.external: the planted token list committed alongside the apk, which is independent of what frisk reports; a scanner that misses a planted token fails regardless of what else it finds
oracle.note: The oracle is independent of the tool, but the corpus is one we authored, so read the figure as full recall on a corpus of our choosing rather than as recall on secrets in the wild. The apkleaks 2.6.3 bar beside it scores 5 of the same 8 on the same file, which is what keeps the corpus from being read as tuned to disrobe alone. The denominator is pinned by equality, so a run that inspects fewer planted secrets scores worse instead of shrinking its own universe.

title: frisk secret recall on the committed planted APK
